metadata.name: AI Agent Democratization Vision
metadata.description: Become the leading visual AI agent creation platform, democratizing AI agent orchestration for 10M+ users globally by making AI agent creation as accessible as visual programming for children. Establish 'Scratch for AI agents' as the go-to platform for anyone wanting to build AI-powered virtual teams.

metadata.name: Platform Foundation & MVP Development
metadata.description: Build the core dual canvas system with Editor Panel overlay system, implement universal node architecture with 7 core node types (agent, task, workflow, artifact_template, checklist, data, artifact_class), implement natural language agent persona/role definition, create Scratch-like visual interface with intuitive drag-and-drop, and create workflow design capabilities with task input/output edges. Launch MVP with comprehensive node metadata schema and user-friendly visual interface within 1 week development sprint.

metadata.name: User Experience & Democratization
metadata.description: Build comprehensive artifact template library with sub-node definitions (Node Definition, Edge Definition, Column Definition), implement automation slider for different skill levels, and build educational onboarding system to make AI agent creation accessible to non-technical users. Focus on democratization and user experience optimization beyond MVP core features.

metadata.name: Marketplace & Ecosystem
metadata.description: Launch workflow marketplace for sharing and monetization, implement artifact template marketplace with revenue sharing for template creators, create community features and collaboration tools, and build developer platform for third-party integrations with custom node type extensions.

metadata.name: AI Agent Innovation
metadata.description: Develop agent builder workflows (AI agents that create other agents with persona/role definitions), implement advanced node system with custom types beyond the 7 core node types, create artifact instance evaluation and feedback system, and build real-time collaboration features with Editor Panel synchronization.

metadata.name: Global Expansion & Scaling
metadata.description: Launch in US, Europe, and Asian markets, implement localization and cultural adaptation, build enterprise features and compliance, and scale infrastructure for 10M+ users.

metadata.name: Educational Platform Leadership
metadata.description: Establish 'Scratch for AI agents' as educational standard, create comprehensive learning curriculum, build certification and assessment system, and partner with educational institutions.

metadata.name: Advanced Template Builder
